items.alt: A document-shaped drawbridge connects Indian exporters and workers with a New Zealand gateway, where a kiwi official welcomes arrivals beside a silver-fern emblem.
Japan’s MMX spacecraft reaches toward rocky Phobos with a sampling arm while a small rover explores the surface against the vast rust-red Mars.
Mohan Bhagwat repairs a cracked bridge with puzzle-shaped stones as people from different walks of life pass pieces across the gap.
A courtroom exhibit shows a tiny recording device and toilet-roll core beside a forensic room diagram while a judge raises a hand during a bail hearing.
A caricatured Real Madrid forward balances a football on a tightrope above a weary red bull mascot as a looming Barcelona-coloured storm signals the Clásico ahead.
A large queue of Alberta voters casts ballots beneath a Canadian flag while a lone cowboy votes beside an oil-pipeline exit ramp.
